# `CameraStateChange`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Envelope-only notification that the camera was opened or closed.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, open_camera @0xd0bc0, close_camera @0xd09b0 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) to all retained sockets when open_camera succeeds or close_camera succeeds; no timer. Carries no camera state, name or path: query the camera getter for the new state. Family N (Event and Timestamp only). APK: the name is a defined constant; no Event branch established.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"CameraStateChange"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, opened - READ shape, not captured:

```json
{"Event":"CameraStateChange","Timestamp":"1234.123456789"}
```
